messages.content: How many heads can I get after tossing 3 coins?

message.content:
When you toss three fair coins, the number of heads you can obtain ranges from 0 to 3.  
Here’s the full probability distribution:

| Heads | Probability |
|-------|-------------|
| 0     | \( \frac{1}{8}\)  |
| 1     | \( \frac{3}{8}\)  |
| 2     | \( \frac{3}{8}\)  |
| 3     | \( \frac{1}{8}\)  |

So you could get anywhere from no heads up to all three heads, with the most likely outcomes being one or two heads (each with a 37.5 % chance).  

If you’re interested in the expected number of heads, it’s simply \(3 \times \frac12 = 1.5\).
